_comment: Stadiums compiled from data/All_Matches_Json venue fields (top 10 IPL venues by match count, deduped across city-suffix variants). pitch drives the engine's conditions stage (src/engine/conditions.py): dusty=spinners bite, green=pacers bite, flat=batting paradise, slow=low & hard to time.

pitch_types.dusty: Dust bowl — turns square, spinners are lethal
pitch_types.green: Green seamer — nip, bounce and movement for pacers
pitch_types.flat: Flat road — batting paradise, boundaries flow
pitch_types.slow: Slow and low — timing is hard, run-making is a grind
